description: No CDASH standard applies (veterinary breed, not a human-subject domain). Detroit's VET form defined the identical Labrador/Poodle/Other list twice under different names for a single-select field (tb0hg85) and a multi-select field (dd7q). Pure deduplication -- both fields keep their own select_one/select_multiple type, only the underlying list is unified.
source: No CDASH standard exists; consolidating identical existing values found within Detroit's own spec
